```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape)

library(gridExtra)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(ggpubr)
library(GGally)
library(ggpmisc)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(patchwork)

library(ggtext)
```

#Bulk assay readouts (for raw data look at end of script)

```{r Fig2a,b - heatmap and hclust of bulk assay data}
all_data_vus = read.csv("data/all_data_vus.csv")
all_data_vus = all_data_vus[-1]
all_data_vus1 = all_data_vus %>% column_to_rownames(var = "variant") %>% select(endo_ratio, campari, puncta_formation, chop, bax_bcl2, nfkb, nfat, bip, abundance)

vus_scaled = data.frame(scale(all_data_vus1, center = FALSE))
dist_matrix_variant = dist(vus_scaled, method = "euclidean")
fviz_dist(dist_matrix_variant)

variables_scaled = t(vus_scaled)
dist_matrix_variables = dist(variables_scaled, method = "euclidean")
fviz_dist(dist_matrix_variables)

hc_var = hclust(dist_matrix_variant, method = "complete")
hc_assay = hclust(dist_matrix_variables, method = "complete")

hc_assay_plot = ggdendrogram(hc_assay)
hc_var_plot = ggdendrogram(hc_var); hc_var_plot
ggsave("plots/hc_assay_plot.pdf", hc_assay_plot, height = 2, width = 2)
ggsave("plots/hc_var_plot.pdf", hc_var_plot, height = 2, width = 3)

hc_var$order

#rotating for clarity
hc_var_dend = as.dendrogram(hc_var)
var_order = c("WT", "R69C", "N80S", "E90D", "E66K", "R69H", "A67T", "K73R", "L74P", "D84N", "F91Y", "H72Q", "D84G", "D76G", "G81D", "G81C", "L96V", "L92V", "D84E")
hc_var_rotated = rotate(hc_var_dend, var_order)
hc_var_rotated_plot = ggdendrogram(hc_var_rotated)
ggsave("plots/hc_var_rotated.pdf", hc_var_rotated_plot, height = 2, width = 3)

vus_scaled1 = vus_scaled
vus_scaled1$variant = rownames(vus_scaled1)
vus_scaled2 = vus_scaled1 %>% melt(id = 'variant')

vus_scaled2$variant = factor(vus_scaled2$variant, c("WT", "R69C", "N80S", "E90D", "A67T", "E66K", "R69H", "K73R", "D84N", "F91Y", "D76G", "H72Q", "D84G", "L74P", "L92V", "D84E", "G81D", "G81C", "L96V"))
vus_scaled2$variable = factor(vus_scaled2$variable, c("endo_ratio", "campari", "aggregation", "abundance", "bax_bcl2" ,"chop", "nfkb", "nfat", "bip"))

vus_scaled_hm = ggplot(data = vus_scaled2, aes(x= variant, y= variable, fill = value))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("blue", "white", "red"),
                       values = scales::rescale(c(0, 1, 2))) + labs(x= NULL, y= NULL)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+NULL; vus_scaled_hm
ggsave("plots/vus_scaled_hm.pdf", vus_scaled_hm, height = 2, width = 4.5)
```

```{r Fig2c,d - PCA of bulk assay data}
pca_vus = prcomp(vus_scaled)
summary(pca_vus)
pca_vus_results = data.frame(pca_vus$x)
pca_vus_results$variant = rownames(pca_vus_results)

pca_vus_rotation = data.frame(pca_vus$rotation)
pca_vus_rotation$variable = rownames(pca_vus_rotation)

pca_vus_results = pca_vus_results %>% mutate(type = case_when(variant %in% c("K73R", "F91Y", "D76G", "G81C", "D84N", "R69C", "R69H", "E90D", "A67T", "E66K", "N80S") ~ "VUS",
                                                        variant %in% c("H72Q", "L92V", "D84G","L74P","G81D","D84E","L96V") ~ "pathogenic"),
                                             allele_freq = case_when(variant %in% c("E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H" ,"N80S", "E90D", "WT") ~ "yes",
                                                                     variant %in% c("K73R", "D84N", "F91Y", "D76G", "G81C", "H72Q", "D84G", "L74P", "L92V", "D84E", "G81D", "L96V") ~ "no"))

vus_variable_pca = ggplot(data = pca_vus_rotation, aes(x= PC1, y= PC2))+
  labs(x= "PC1 (55% Variance)", y= "PC2 (15% Variance)")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.25)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.25)+
  geom_segment(data = pca_vus_rotation, aes(x= 0, y= 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm")))+
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = variable), hjust = 0) + NULL; vus_variable_pca

ggsave("plots/vus_variable_pca.pdf", vus_variable_pca, height = 3, width = 4)

vus_pca_plot = ggplot()+
  labs(x= "PC1 (55% Variance)", y= "PC2 (15% Variance)")+
  # geom_point(data = pca_vus_results %>% filter(allele_freq == "yes"), aes(x= PC1, PC2), size = 3)+
  geom_point(data = pca_vus_results, aes(x= PC1, y= PC2, color = type))+ 
  geom_text_repel(data = pca_vus_results, aes(x= PC1, y= PC2, label = variant, color = type))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+NULL; vus_pca_plot

ggsave("plots/vus_vus_pca.pdf", vus_pca_plot, height = 3, width = 4)

ggplot(data = pca_vus_rotation, aes(x= PC1, y= PC3))+
  labs(x= "PC1 (55% Variance)", y= "PC3 (13% Variance)")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.25)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.25)+
  geom_segment(data = pca_vus_rotation, aes(x= 0, y= 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC3), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm")))+
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = variable), hjust = 0)



vus_scaled2 = vus_scaled2 %>% mutate(type = case_when(variant %in% c("WT", "R69C", "N80S", "E90D", "A67T", "E66K", "R69H") ~ "gnomad",
                                                      variant %in% c("K73R", "D84N", "F91Y", "D76G", "G81C") ~ "VUS",
                                                      variant %in% c("H72Q", "D84G", "L74P", "L92V", "D84E", "G81D", "L96V") ~ "path"))

bulk_assay_hist = ggplot()+
  geom_histogram(data = vus_scaled2 %>% filter(variable %in% c("endo_ratio", "campari", "aggregation")), aes(x= value, fill = type), color = "black", alpha = 0.75, bins = 15)+ 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gnomad" = "deeppink3", "VUS" = "white", "path" = "darkgreen"))+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(variable), scales = "free_y") + theme(legend.position = "none")+NULL; bulk_assay_hist

ggsave("plots/bulk_assay_hist.pdf", bulk_assay_hist, height = 2.5, width = 3)
```

#Initial data processing for growth and calcium influx scores
```{r data for gating strategy schematic}
all_flow = read.csv("data/dms_flow_run.csv") %>% mutate(sample = case_when(SampleID == 1 ~ "g1_e66k",
                                                                         SampleID == 2 ~ "g1_e90x",
                                                                         SampleID == 3 ~ "g1_g81d",
                                                                         SampleID == 4 ~ "g1_g81d",
                                                                         SampleID == 5 ~ "g1_lib_mix",
                                                                         SampleID == 6 ~ "g1_l92v",
                                                                         SampleID == 7 ~ "g1_l92v",
                                                                         SampleID == 8 ~ "g2_e66k",
                                                                         SampleID == 9 ~ "g2_e90x",
                                                                         SampleID == 10 ~ "g2_g81d",
                                                                         SampleID == 11 ~ "g2_l92v",
                                                                         SampleID == 12 ~ "g2_r3_sort",
                                                                         SampleID == 13 ~ "g1_r3_sort",
                                                                         SampleID == 14 ~ "g2_r4_sort",
                                                                         SampleID == 15 ~ "g1_r4_sort",
                                                                         SampleID == 16 ~ "r3_recombrate",
                                                                         SampleID == 17 ~ "r3_recombrate",
                                                                         SampleID == 18 ~ "r4_recombrate",
                                                                         SampleID == 19 ~ "g1_r69c",
                                                                         SampleID == 20 ~ "g1_r5_sort",
                                                                         SampleID == 21 ~ "g2_r5_sort",
                                                                         SampleID == 22 ~ "r5_recombrate"))

all_flow = all_flow %>% filter(FSC.A < 175000 & FSC.A > 50000 & SSC.A < 175000 & SSC.A > 50000)
flow_sort = all_flow %>% filter(sample %in% c("g1_r3_sort", "g2_r3_sort", "g1_r4_sort", "g2_r4_sort", "g1_r5_sort", "g2_r5_sort"))

sort_gate_plot_g1 = ggplot(data = flow_sort %>% filter(sample %in% c("g1_r3_sort", "g1_r4_sort", "g1_r5_sort")), aes(x= YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A))+
  geom_density(fill = "grey", linewidth = 1)+ scale_x_log10(limits= c(0.01, 10)) +
  geom_density(data = all_flow %>% filter(sample %in% c("g1_e90x")), aes(x= YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A), alpha = 0.15, fill = "blue", linewidth = 0.75, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_density(data = all_flow %>% filter(sample %in% c("g1_g81d")), aes(x= YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A), alpha = 0.15, fill = "red", linewidth = 0.75, color = "darkred") + labs(x= NULL, y= NULL) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = c(0.15, 0.5, 0.85)), linetype = "dashed")+NULL; sort_gate_plot_g1

sort_gate_plot_g2 = ggplot(data = flow_sort %>% filter(sample %in% c("g2_r3_sort", "g2_r4_sort", "g2_r5_sort")), aes(x= YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A))+
  geom_density(fill = "grey", linewidth = 1)+ scale_x_log10(limits= c(0.01, 10)) +
  geom_density(data = all_flow %>% filter(sample %in% c("g2_e90x")), aes(x= YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A), alpha = 0.15, fill = "blue", linewidth = 0.75, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_density(data = all_flow %>% filter(sample %in% c("g2_g81d")), aes(x= YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A), alpha = 0.15, fill = "red", linewidth = 0.75, color = "darkred") + labs(x= NULL, y= NULL) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = c(0.35, 0.52, 0.92)), linetype = "dashed")+NULL; sort_gate_plot_g2

ggsave("plots/sort_gate_plot_g1.pdf", sort_gate_plot_g1, height = 0.75, width = 2)
ggsave("plots/sort_gate_plot_g2.pdf", sort_gate_plot_g2, height = 0.75, width = 2)

all_flow %>% distinct(sample)

#for percentages in fig 3a

distinct(all_flow, sample)
g1 = all_flow %>% filter(sample %in% c("g1_e66k", "g1_e90x", "g1_g81d", "g1_l92v", "g1_r69c"))
g2 = all_flow %>% filter(sample %in% c("g2_e66k", "g2_e90x", "g2_g81d", "g2_l92v", "g2_r69c"))

#gating strategy A
flow_sort_run2_g1_a = g1 %>% filter(YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A < quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.15))
flow_sort_run2_g1_a = count(flow_sort_run2_g1_a, sample)
colnames(flow_sort_run2_g1_a)[2] = "bin_a"
flow_sort_run2_g1_a <- setNames(data.frame(t(flow_sort_run2_g1_a[-1])), flow_sort_run2_g1_a[[1]])

flow_sort_run2_g1_b = g1 %>% filter(YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A > quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.15) & YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A < quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.5))
flow_sort_run2_g1_b = count(flow_sort_run2_g1_b, sample) 
colnames(flow_sort_run2_g1_b)[2] = "bin_b"
flow_sort_run2_g1_b <- setNames(data.frame(t(flow_sort_run2_g1_b[-1])), flow_sort_run2_g1_b[[1]])

flow_sort_run2_g1_c = g1 %>% filter(YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A > quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.5) & YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A < quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.85))
flow_sort_run2_g1_c = count(flow_sort_run2_g1_c, sample) 
colnames(flow_sort_run2_g1_c)[2] = "bin_c"
flow_sort_run2_g1_c <- setNames(data.frame(t(flow_sort_run2_g1_c[-1])), flow_sort_run2_g1_c[[1]])

flow_sort_run2_g1_d = g1 %>% filter(YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A > quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.85))
flow_sort_run2_g1_d = count(flow_sort_run2_g1_d, sample)
colnames(flow_sort_run2_g1_d)[2] = "bin_d"
flow_sort_run2_g1_d <- setNames(data.frame(t(flow_sort_run2_g1_d[-1])), flow_sort_run2_g1_d[[1]])

g1_pct = rbind(flow_sort_run2_g1_a, flow_sort_run2_g1_b, flow_sort_run2_g1_c, flow_sort_run2_g1_d)
g1_pct1 = g1_pct %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . / sum(., na.rm = TRUE) * 100))


#gating strategy B
flow_sort_run2_g2_a = g2 %>% filter(YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A < quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.15))
flow_sort_run2_g2_a = count(flow_sort_run2_g2_a, sample)
colnames(flow_sort_run2_g2_a)[2] = "bin_a"
flow_sort_run2_g2_a <- setNames(data.frame(t(flow_sort_run2_g2_a[-1])), flow_sort_run2_g2_a[[1]])

flow_sort_run2_g2_b = g2 %>% filter(YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A > quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.15) & YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A < quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.5))
flow_sort_run2_g2_b = count(flow_sort_run2_g2_b, sample) 
colnames(flow_sort_run2_g2_b)[2] = "bin_b"
flow_sort_run2_g2_b <- setNames(data.frame(t(flow_sort_run2_g2_b[-1])), flow_sort_run2_g2_b[[1]])

flow_sort_run2_g2_c = g2 %>% filter(YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A > quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.5) & YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A < quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.85))
flow_sort_run2_g2_c = count(flow_sort_run2_g2_c, sample) 
colnames(flow_sort_run2_g2_c)[2] = "bin_c"
flow_sort_run2_g2_c <- setNames(data.frame(t(flow_sort_run2_g2_c[-1])), flow_sort_run2_g2_c[[1]])

flow_sort_run2_g2_d = g2 %>% filter(YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A > quantile(flow_sort$YG.586_15.A.B.515_20.A, probs = 0.85))
flow_sort_run2_g2_d = count(flow_sort_run2_g2_d, sample)
colnames(flow_sort_run2_g2_d)[2] = "bin_d"
flow_sort_run2_g2_d <- setNames(data.frame(t(flow_sort_run2_g2_d[-1])), flow_sort_run2_g2_d[[1]])

g2_pct = rbind(flow_sort_run2_g2_a, flow_sort_run2_g2_b, flow_sort_run2_g2_c, flow_sort_run2_g2_d)
g2_pct1 = g2_pct %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . / sum(., na.rm = TRUE) * 100))

```


```{r Sort-seq data}
variant_name = read.csv("data/variant_name.csv")
counts_g1 = read.csv("data/counts_gate1.csv")
counts_g1 = counts_g1[-1]

counts_g1 = counts_g1 %>% mutate(fr3g1_a = r3g1_a/sum(r3g1_a, na.rm = T),
                                 fr3g1_b = r3g1_b/sum(r3g1_b, na.rm = T),
                                 fr3g1_c = r3g1_c/sum(r3g1_c, na.rm = T),
                                 fr3g1_d = r3g1_d/sum(r3g1_d, na.rm = T),
                                 fr4g1_a = r4g1_a/sum(r4g1_a, na.rm = T),
                                 fr4g1_b = r4g1_b/sum(r4g1_b, na.rm = T),
                                 fr4g1_c = r4g1_c/sum(r4g1_c, na.rm = T),
                                 fr4g1_d = r4g1_d/sum(r4g1_d, na.rm = T),
                                 fr5g1_a = r5g1_a/sum(r5g1_a, na.rm = T),
                                 fr5g1_b = r5g1_b/sum(r5g1_b, na.rm = T),
                                 fr5g1_c = r5g1_c/sum(r5g1_c, na.rm = T),
                                 fr5g1_d = r5g1_d/sum(r5g1_d, na.rm = T))
counts_g1 = counts_g1 %>% mutate(wr3 = ((fr3g1_a * 0.15)+ (fr3g1_b * 0.5) + (fr3g1_c * 0.85) + (fr3g1_d * 1))/(fr3g1_a + fr3g1_b + fr3g1_c + fr3g1_d),
                                 wr4 = ((fr4g1_a * 0.15)+ (fr4g1_b * 0.5) + (fr4g1_c * 0.85) + (fr4g1_d * 1))/(fr4g1_a + fr4g1_b + fr4g1_c + fr4g1_d),
                                 wr5 = ((fr5g1_a * 0.15)+ (fr5g1_b * 0.5) + (fr5g1_c * 0.85) + (fr5g1_d * 1))/(fr5g1_a + fr5g1_b + fr5g1_c + fr5g1_d))

weighted_freq_g1 = counts_g1 %>% select(1:4,17:31)

ggplot(data = weighted_freq_g1, aes(x= fr3g1_d, y= fr4g1_d))+ scale_y_log10()+ scale_x_log10()+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5)

weighted_freq_g1lg = weighted_freq_g1 %>% select(4:16) %>% melt()




weighted_freq_g1$g1_score <- 10^(rowMeans(log10(weighted_freq_g1[, c("wr3", "wr4", "wr5")]), na.rm = TRUE))

weighted_freq_g1 = weighted_freq_g1 %>% mutate(type = case_when(start == end ~ "syn",
                                                                end == "_" ~ "non",
                                                                start != end & end != "_" ~ "mis"))

ggplot(data = weighted_freq_g1, aes(x= g1_score))+
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(type)) +
  geom_histogram(data = weighted_freq_g1 %>% filter(variant %in% c("H72Q", "D84G", "L92V", "L96V", "G81D")), aes(x = g1_score, fill = variant)) +
  geom_histogram(data = weighted_freq_g1 %>% filter(variant %in% c("E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H")), aes(x = g1_score), fill = "black")

#starting with gating strategy 2
counts_g2 = read.csv("data/counts_gate2.csv")
counts_g2 = counts_g2[-1]
counts_g2 = counts_g2 %>% mutate(fr3g2_a = r3g2_a/sum(r3g2_a, na.rm = T),
                                 fr3g2_b = r3g2_b/sum(r3g2_b, na.rm = T),
                                 fr3g2_c = r3g2_c/sum(r3g2_c, na.rm = T),
                                 fr3g2_d = r3g2_d/sum(r3g2_d, na.rm = T),
                                 fr4g2_a = r4g2_a/sum(r4g2_a, na.rm = T),
                                 fr4g2_b = r4g2_b/sum(r4g2_b, na.rm = T),
                                 fr4g2_c = r4g2_c/sum(r4g2_c, na.rm = T),
                                 fr4g2_d = r4g2_d/sum(r4g2_d, na.rm = T),
                                 fr5g2_a = r5g2_a/sum(r5g2_a, na.rm = T),
                                 fr5g2_b = r5g2_b/sum(r5g2_b, na.rm = T),
                                 fr5g2_c = r5g2_c/sum(r5g2_c, na.rm = T),
                                 fr5g2_d = r5g2_d/sum(r5g2_d, na.rm = T))
counts_g2 = counts_g2 %>% mutate(wr3 = ((fr3g2_a * 0.35)+ (fr3g2_b * 0.52) + (fr3g2_c * 0.92) + (fr3g2_d * 1))/(fr3g2_a + fr3g2_b + fr3g2_c + fr3g2_d),
                                 wr4 = ((fr4g2_a * 0.35)+ (fr4g2_b * 0.52) + (fr4g2_c * 0.92) + (fr4g2_d * 1))/(fr4g2_a + fr4g2_b + fr4g2_c + fr4g2_d),
                                 wr5 = ((fr5g2_a * 0.35)+ (fr5g2_b * 0.52) + (fr5g2_c * 0.92) + (fr5g2_d * 1))/(fr5g2_a + fr5g2_b + fr5g2_c + fr5g2_d))
weighted_freq_g2 = counts_g2 %>% select(1:4,17:31)


weighted_freq_g2$g2_score <- 10^(rowMeans(log10(weighted_freq_g2[, c("wr3", "wr4", "wr5")]), na.rm = TRUE))

weighted_freq_g2 = weighted_freq_g2 %>% mutate(type = case_when(start == end ~ "syn",
                                                                end == "_" ~ "non",
                                                                start != end & end != "_" ~ "mis"))


ggplot(data = weighted_freq_g2, aes(x= g2_score))+
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(type)) +
  geom_histogram(data = weighted_freq_g2 %>% filter(variant %in% c("H72Q", "D84G", "L92V", "L96V", "G81D")), aes(x = g2_score, fill = variant)) +
  geom_histogram(data = weighted_freq_g2 %>% filter(variant %in% c("E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H")), aes(x = g2_score), fill = "black")

g1_score = weighted_freq_g1 %>% select(variant, g1_score)
g2_score = weighted_freq_g2 %>% select(variant, g2_score)
sortseq_score = left_join(g1_score, g2_score)

sortseq_score[sortseq_score == "Z0Z"] <- "WT"

#checking that gating strategies yield similar scores and can be combined
gating_comp = ggplot(data = sortseq_score, aes(x= g1_score, y= g2_score))+ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.4,1))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 1) + labs(x = "Gate A", y= "Gate B")+NULL; gating_comp 
  # geom_point(data = sortseq_score %>% filter(variant %in% c("L96V", "L92V", "D84E", "G81D")), aes(x= g1_score, y= g2_score), color = "red")+
  # geom_point(data = sortseq_score %>% filter(variant %in% c("H72Q", "D84G", "L74P")), aes(x= g1_score, y= g2_score), color = "orange")+
  # geom_point(data = sortseq_score %>% filter(variant %in% c("E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H", "N80S", "E90D")), aes(x= g1_score, y= g2_score), color = "green")+
  # geom_point(data = sortseq_score %>% filter(variant %in% c("F91Y", "G81C", "D76G", "K73R")), aes(x= g1_score, y= g2_score), color = "blue")+
  # geom_text_repel(data = sortseq_score %>% filter(variant %in% c("F91Y", "G81C", "D76G", "K73R")), aes(x= g1_score, y= g2_score, label= variant))

ggsave("plots/gating_comp.pdf", gating_comp, height = 2.5, width = 3)
cor.test(sortseq_score$g1_score, sortseq_score$g2_score, method = "spearman")

sortseq_score$ca_score = 10^(rowMeans(log10(sortseq_score[, c("g1_score", "g2_score")]), na.rm = TRUE))
#converting final_score to NA if less than 2 scores have values for that variant
sortseq_score <- sortseq_score %>%
  mutate(
    non_na_count = (!is.na(g1_score)) + (!is.na(g2_score)),
    ca_score = ifelse(non_na_count == 1, NA, ca_score)
  )

sortseq_score = left_join(variant_name, sortseq_score)

sortseq_score = sortseq_score %>% mutate(type = case_when(start == end ~ "syn",
                                                    end == "_" ~ "non",
                                                    start != end & end != "_" ~ "mis"))

all_scores = sortseq_score %>% select(variant, ca_score, type)
```

#Growth scores are labeled as 'growth_ratio' or 'growth_log_ratio' and survival scores from Kamath & Matreyek, 2025 are labeled as 'endo_ratio' or 'endo_log_ratio'

```{r Growth scores}
#composite growth score

growth = read.csv("data/growth.csv")
growth = growth[-1]

## Figure out the total number of reads per sample
growth_readcounts <- data.frame("total_count" = colSums(growth[,c("lib", "r3_growth", "r4_growth", "r5_growth")], na.rm = T))
lod_frame <- read.csv(file = "data/Sampling_limit_of_detection.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

growth_lod_readcounts <- c()
growth_lod_freqs <- c()
for(re in growth_readcounts$total_count){
  temp_subset <- (lod_frame %>% mutate(abs_diff = abs(reads - re)) %>% arrange(abs_diff))[1,]
  growth_lod_readcounts <- c(growth_lod_readcounts, temp_subset$count)
  growth_lod_freqs <- c(growth_lod_freqs, temp_subset$freq)
}
growth_lod_dataframe <- data.frame("reads" = growth_readcounts, "count" = growth_lod_readcounts, "freq" = growth_lod_freqs)

## Now figure out which data points were below the limit of detection
growth[is.na(growth)] <- 0

growth_raw_counts2 <- data.frame("variant" = growth$variant,
                           "lib" = growth$lib < growth_lod_readcounts[1],
                           "r3" = growth$r3_growth < growth_lod_readcounts[2],
                           "r4" = growth$r4_growth < growth_lod_readcounts[3],
                           "r5" = growth$r5_growth < growth_lod_readcounts[4])

## These were the total number of variants below the limit of detection in each endo sequencing run:
colSums(growth_raw_counts2[,c("lib","r3","r4","r5")])

## Now calculate endo frequencies, and for endos below the limit of detection, give them the limit of detection frequency value
growth_freq = growth %>% mutate(flib = lib/growth_readcounts$total_count[1],
                                      fr3 = r3_growth/growth_readcounts$total_count[2],
                                      fr4 = r4_growth/growth_readcounts$total_count[3],
                                      fr5 = r5_growth/growth_readcounts$total_count[4])

growth_freq[growth_raw_counts2$lib == T,"flib"] <- growth_lod_freqs[1]
growth_freq[growth_raw_counts2$r3 == T,"fr3"] <- growth_lod_freqs[2]
growth_freq[growth_raw_counts2$r4 == T,"fr4"] <- growth_lod_freqs[3]
growth_freq[growth_raw_counts2$r5 == T,"fr5"] <- growth_lod_freqs[4]

growth_freq$r3_ratio <- growth_freq$fr3 / growth_freq$flib
growth_freq$r4_ratio <- growth_freq$fr4 / growth_freq$flib
growth_freq$r5_ratio <- growth_freq$fr5 / growth_freq$flib

growth_freq$growth_ratio <- 10^rowMeans(log10(growth_freq[,c("r3_ratio", "r4_ratio", "r5_ratio")]))


growth_freq1 = growth_freq %>% select(variant, growth_ratio)
growth_freq1[growth_freq1 == "Z0Z"] <- "WT"

prev_scores = read.csv("data/prev_survival_scores.csv") %>% select(variant, endo_ratio)

growth = left_join(variant_name, growth_freq1)
growth = left_join(growth, prev_scores)
growth = growth %>% mutate(log_growth_ratio = log10(growth_ratio),
                               log_endo_ratio = log10(endo_ratio))

all_scores  = full_join(all_scores, growth)

#Figure 3A
growth_survival_hist = ggplot()+
  geom_histogram(data = all_scores, aes(x= log_endo_ratio), alpha = 0.5, fill = "blue", color = "black", bins = 15, linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_histogram(data = all_scores, aes(x= log_growth_ratio), alpha = 0.5, fill = "grey", color = "black", bins = 15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, alpha = 0.5)+NULL; growth_survival_hist
ggsave("plots/growth_survival_hist.pdf", growth_survival_hist, height = 1.5, width = 2.5)

#Figure 3B
growth_survival_dotplot = ggplot()+
  labs(x= "Survival score", y= "Growth score")+
  geom_point(data = all_scores, aes(x= log_endo_ratio, y= log_growth_ratio), alpha = 0.3, shape = 16, size = 1)+ 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +NULL; growth_survival_dotplot
ggsave("plots/growth_survival_dotplot.pdf", growth_survival_dotplot, height = 1.75, width = 2)

cor.test(all_scores$log_endo_ratio, all_scores$log_growth_ratio, method = "spearman")

#Figure 3C
mis_positional <- all_scores %>% group_by(start, position) %>% summarize(ca_score = mean(ca_score, na.rm = T), log_growth_ratio = mean(log_growth_ratio, na.rm = T), log_endo_ratio = mean(log_endo_ratio, na.rm = T)) %>% mutate(label1 = paste0(start,position))

mis_positional = mis_positional %>% mutate(domain = case_when(position %in% c(63:75) ~ "a1",
                                                              position %in% c(76:87) ~ "loop",
                                                              position %in% c(88:98) ~ "a2"))

positional_survival_growth_plot = ggplot() +
  labs(x= "Survival score", y= "Growth score")+
  geom_point(data = mis_positional, aes(x= log_endo_ratio, y= log_growth_ratio), alpha = 0.5, shape = 16, size = 1)+ 
  geom_text_repel(data = mis_positional, aes(x= log_endo_ratio, y= log_growth_ratio, label = position), size = 2.5, box.padding = 0, segment.alpha = 0.4, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+NULL; positional_survival_growth_plot; ggsave(file = "Plots/positional_survival_growth_plot.pdf", positional_survival_growth_plot, height = 1.75, width = 2)

cor(mis_positional$log_growth_ratio, mis_positional$log_endo_ratio, use = "complete", method = "spearman")
```

```{r Figure 4}
  geom_text_repel(data = wt_score, aes(x= ca_score, y= log_growth_ratio, label = variant), size = 3)+
  geom_point(data = snv_scores, aes(x= ca_score, y= log_growth_ratio), shape = 1, alpha = 0.2, size = 1)+ 
  # geom_point(data = all_scores %>% filter(type == "syn"), aes(x= ca_score, y= log_growth_ratio), alpha = 0.3, color = "lightgreen", shape = 16)+ 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("GnomAD" = "green4", "pathogenic" = "red", "VUS" = "purple")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dotted") +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = 0.7, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_text_repel(data = clinvar_vus2, aes(x= ca_score, y= log_growth_ratio, label = variant, color = class), size = 3) +

  NULL; all_campari_growth_plot; ggsave(file = "Plots/all_campari_growth_plot.pdf", all_campari_growth_plot, height = 2.75, width = 3.75)
```

```{r Figure 5}
alpha_missense <- read.delim(file = "data/alpha_missense.tsv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F) %>% mutate(variant = protein_variant)

alpha_missense2 <- merge(alpha_missense[,c("variant","am_pathogenicity","am_class")], all_scores, by = "variant")
alpha_missense2_clinvar <- merge(alpha_missense2, clinvar_vus2[,c("variant","class")], by = "variant") %>% filter(class %in% c("VUS","GnomAD","pathogenic"))

alphamissense <- alpha_missense2_clinvar #read.delim(file = "Data/250530_AlphaMissense-Search-P35475.tsv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
alphamissense2 <- alphamissense #merge(alphamissense, gnomad3 %>% mutate(protein.variant = Protein.Consequence), by = "protein.variant")

am2_thresholds <- seq(0,1,0.01)
am2_roc_df <- data.frame("threshold" = am2_thresholds, "tpr" = NA, "fpr" = NA)
for(x in 1:nrow(am2_roc_df)){
  temp_threshold <- am2_roc_df$threshold[x]
  pathog_true_pos <- nrow(subset(alphamissense2, am_pathogenicity >= temp_threshold & class == "pathogenic"))
  pathog_false_neg <- nrow(subset(alphamissense2, am_pathogenicity < temp_threshold & class == "pathogenic"))
  pathog_false_pos <- nrow(subset(alphamissense2, am_pathogenicity >= temp_threshold & class == "GnomAD"))
  pathog_true_neg <- nrow(subset(alphamissense2, am_pathogenicity < temp_threshold & class == "GnomAD"))
  am2_roc_df$tpr[x] <- pathog_true_pos / (pathog_true_pos + pathog_false_neg)
  am2_roc_df$fpr[x] <- pathog_false_pos / (pathog_false_pos + pathog_true_neg)
}
am2_line <- am2_roc_df %>% arrange(fpr, tpr) %>% select(fpr, tpr) %>% distinct()

roc_pts_am <- bind_rows(data.frame(fpr = 0, tpr = 0), am2_line, data.frame(fpr = 1, tpr = 1)) %>% arrange(fpr, tpr) %>% distinct()

amscore_auc <- sum(diff(roc_pts_am$fpr) * (head(roc_pts_am$tpr, -1) + tail(roc_pts_am$tpr, -1)) / 2)

paste0("AlphaMissense AUC: ", round(amscore_auc, 2))

am2_line_auc <- rbind(am2_line %>% filter(tpr != 1) %>% group_by(tpr) %>% summarize(fpr = max(fpr)) %>% mutate(area = 0),c(1,1,0))
for(x in 2:nrow(am2_line_auc)){
  am2_line_auc$area[x] <- (am2_line_auc$tpr[x] - am2_line_auc$tpr[x-1]) * am2_line_auc$fpr[x-1]
}
paste0("AUC: ", round(1-(sum(am2_line_auc$area)),2))

cascore_thresholds <- seq(0.35,0.9,0.01)

  pathog_true_pos <- nrow(subset(clinvar_vus2, ca_score >= temp_threshold & class == "pathogenic"))
  pathog_false_neg <- nrow(subset(clinvar_vus2, ca_score < temp_threshold & class == "pathogenic"))
  pathog_false_pos <- nrow(subset(clinvar_vus2, ca_score >= temp_threshold & class == "GnomAD"))
  pathog_true_neg <- nrow(subset(clinvar_vus2, ca_score < temp_threshold & class == "GnomAD"))
  cascore_roc_df$tpr[x] <- pathog_true_pos / (pathog_true_pos + pathog_false_neg)
  cascore_roc_df$fpr[x] <- pathog_false_pos / (pathog_false_pos + pathog_true_neg)
}

##OddsPath scores for calcium influx scores

#OddsPath1
#benign set of variants as GnomAD variants with Allele Count > 1
gnomad_ef1 = left_join(clinvar_vus2, gnomad_ef) %>% filter(Allele.Count > 1)

benign <- clinvar_vus2 %>% filter(class == "GnomAD" & variant %in% gnomad_ef1$variant)

pathogenic <- clinvar_vus2 %>% filter(class == "pathogenic")

ref <- bind_rows(pathogenic %>% mutate(class1 = 1), benign %>% mutate(class1 = 0)) %>% distinct(variant, .keep_all = TRUE)

#split into training and test dataset
set.seed(96)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(ref)), size = floor(0.5 * nrow(ref)))
train <- ref[train_idx, ]
test  <- ref[-train_idx, ]

#finding threshold value using ROC curve
roc_obj <- roc(response = train$class1, predictor = train$ca_score,
               direction = "<", quiet = TRUE) 
best <- coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
               best.method = "youden")
threshold <- best$threshold
print(best)

ggroc(roc_obj, legacy.axes = TRUE, color = "#2c7bb6", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "ROC Curve", x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate") +
  theme_minimal()

#OddsPath1 score using threshold on training data
abnormal <- function(x) x >= threshold  

a <- sum(test$class1 == 1 & abnormal(test$ca_score), na.rm = T) 
n_p <- sum(test$class1 == 1)
b <- sum(test$class1 == 0 & abnormal(test$ca_score), na.rm = T)  
n_b <- sum(test$class1 == 0)

p_abn_path <- (a + 0.5) / (n_p + 1)
p_nor_path <- (n_p - a + 0.5) / (n_p + 1)
p_abn_ben  <- (b + 0.5) / (n_b + 1)
p_nor_ben  <- (n_b - b + 0.5) / (n_b + 1)

OP_abnormal <- p_abn_path / p_abn_ben
OP_normal   <- p_nor_path / p_nor_ben


clinvar_vus2 <- clinvar_vus2 %>% mutate(OddsPath = ifelse(abnormal(ca_score), OP_abnormal, OP_normal))

all_scores <- all_scores %>% mutate(OddsPath = ifelse(abnormal(ca_score), OP_abnormal, OP_normal))


#OddsPath2
#Using synonymous variants as benign dataset
benign1 <- all_scores %>% filter(type == "syn")

ref1 <- bind_rows(pathogenic %>% mutate(class1 = 1), benign1 %>% mutate(class1 = 0)) %>% distinct(variant, .keep_all = TRUE)


set.seed(96)
train_idx1 <- sample(seq_len(nrow(ref1)), size = floor(0.5 * nrow(ref1)))
train1 <- ref1[train_idx1, ]
test1  <- ref1[-train_idx1, ]

roc_obj1 <- roc(response = train1$class1, predictor = train1$ca_score,
               direction = "<", quiet = TRUE) 
best1 <- coords(roc_obj1, "best", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
               best.method = "youden")
threshold1 <- best1$threshold
print(best1)

ggroc(roc_obj1, legacy.axes = TRUE, color = "#2c7bb6", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "ROC Curve", x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate") +
  theme_minimal()

abnormal1 <- function(x) x >= threshold1 

a1 <- sum(test1$class1 == 1 & abnormal(test1$ca_score), na.rm = T)  
n_p1 <- sum(test1$class1 == 1)
b1 <- sum(test1$class1 == 0 & abnormal(test1$ca_score), na.rm = T)  
n_b1 <- sum(test1$class1 == 0)

p_abn_path1 <- (a1 + 0.5) / (n_p1 + 1)
p_nor_path1 <- (n_p1 - a1 + 0.5) / (n_p1 + 1)
p_abn_ben1  <- (b1 + 0.5) / (n_b1 + 1)
p_nor_ben1  <- (n_b1 - b1 + 0.5) / (n_b1 + 1)

OP_abnormal1 <- p_abn_path1 / p_abn_ben1
OP_normal1   <- p_nor_path1 / p_nor_ben1

clinvar_vus2 <- clinvar_vus2 %>%
  mutate(OddsPath1 = ifelse(abnormal1(ca_score), OP_abnormal1, OP_normal1))

all_scores <- all_scores %>%
  mutate(OddsPath1 = ifelse(abnormal1(ca_score), OP_abnormal1, OP_normal1))


all_scores = all_scores %>% mutate(prediction = case_when(OddsPath1 < 0.3 ~ "likely_benign",
                                                          OddsPath1 >= 30 ~ "likely_pathogenic"))

oddspath_plot = ggplot(data = all_scores, aes(x= ca_score, fill = prediction))+ 
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", bins = 15)+ labs(x = "Calcium Influx Score", y= "Count", fill = "Odds Path Score prediction")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = best1$threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+ theme(legend.position = "none")+NULL; oddspath_plot

ggsave("plots/oddspath_plot.pdf", oddspath_plot, height = 1, width = 2.75)
```

```{r CaMPARI2 targeted, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
ecr = bind_rows(ecr2, ecr3, ecr4) %>% select(variant, replicate,Live.Singlets.Q4..V450.A....R670.A..B515.A....Freq..of.Parent...., Live.Singlets.Q4..V450.A....R670.A..G575.A....Freq..of.Parent...., Live.Singlets.Q5..V450.A....B515.A....Geometric.Mean..B515.A., Live.Singlets.Q5..V450.A....B515.A....Geometric.Mean..G575.A.) %>% rename_with(~c("variant", "replicate", "pct_green", "pct_red", "gmean_green", "gmean_red")) %>% mutate(ratio = gmean_red / gmean_green)

ecr = ecr %>% group_by(variant, replicate) %>% mutate(repgmean_red = 10^mean(log10(gmean_red)),
                                                      repgmean_green = 10^mean(log10(gmean_green)),
                                                      repgmean_ratio = 10^mean(log10(ratio)))
ecr = bind_rows(ecr, ecr1_edit)

ggplot() + scale_x_log10() + geom_histogram(data = ecr, aes(x = gmean_green, fill = variant), bins = 20) + facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate))
ggplot() + scale_x_log10() + geom_histogram(data = ecr, aes(x = gmean_red, fill = variant), bins = 20) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate))
ggplot() + scale_x_log10() + geom_histogram(data = ecr, aes(x = ratio, fill = variant), bins = 20) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate))

ecr_varmean = ecr %>% group_by(variant) %>% summarize(mean_ratio = 10^mean(log10(repgmean_ratio)), sd_ratio = 10^sd(log10(repgmean_ratio))) %>% mutate(cv = sd_ratio / mean_ratio) 
ecr = ecr %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(median_ratio = median(repgmean_ratio))
ecr$variant = factor(ecr$variant, c("vif","WT", "R429C", "R304W", "E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H", "N80S", "E90D", "K73R", "D76G","G81C", "D84N",  "F91Y", "H72Q", "G81D", "D84E", "L92V", "L96V", "L74P", "D84G"))

campari_raw_plot = ggplot(data = ecr %>% distinct(variant, ratio, replicate), aes(x= variant, y= ratio, color = replicate))+
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) + scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.01, 10))+
  labs(x= "Variant", y= "CaMPARI2 \nred:green ratio")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
  geom_point(data = ecr_varmean, aes(x= variant, y= mean_ratio), color = "black", shape = 45, size = 3)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.3578594, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5)+NULL; campari_raw_plot

all_campari = ggplot(data = ecr %>% distinct(variant, repgmean_ratio), aes(x= variant, y= repgmean_ratio))+
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.5) + scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.01, 10))+
  labs(x= "Variant", y= "CaMPARI2 \nred:green ratio")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
  geom_point(data = ecr_varmean, aes(x= variant, y= mean_ratio), color = "red", shape = 45, size = 5)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.3578594, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5)+NULL; all_campari
ggsave("plots/fig2_rawdata/all_campari.pdf", all_campari, height = 1.5, width = 6)
```

```{r abundance, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
abr1 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/abundance/r1.csv") %>% mutate(replicate = "1")
abr2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/abundance/r2.csv") %>% mutate(replicate = "2")
abr3 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/abundance/r3.csv") %>% mutate(replicate = "3")
abr4 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/abundance/r4.csv") %>% mutate(replicate = "4")
abr5 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/abundance/r5.csv") %>% mutate(replicate = "5")

ab = bind_rows(abr1, abr2, abr3, abr4, abr5); ab = ab[-1]; ab = ab[-8]
colnames(ab)
colnames(ab) = c("pct_live", "pct_mcherry", "gmean_green", "median_green", "mode_green", "variant", "replicate")
ab$variant = factor(ab$variant, c("vif","vif + TG","WT","WT + TG","R429C", "R304W","E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H", "N80S", "E90D", "K73R", "D76G","G81C", "D84N",  "F91Y", "H72Q", "G81D", "D84E", "L92V", "L96V", "L74P", "D84G"))

ab = ab %>% filter(!(variant %in% c("vif","vif + TG"))) %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(var_gmean = 10^mean(log10(gmean_green)),
                                              var_median = 10^mean(log10(median_green)),
                                              var_mode = 10^mean(log10(mode_green)))

## Scaled
ab_rep_medians <- ab %>% filter(variant != "vif") %>% group_by(replicate) %>% summarize(med_gmean = median(gmean_green, na.rm = T),
                                                        med_median = median(median_green, na.rm = T))
ab_med_gmean <- median(ab_rep_medians$med_gmean)

ab_rep1 <- ab %>% filter(replicate == 1) %>% mutate(scaled_gmean_green = gmean_green / ab_rep_medians$med_gmean[1] * ab_med_gmean)
ab_rep2 <- ab %>% filter(replicate == 2) %>% mutate(scaled_gmean_green = gmean_green / ab_rep_medians$med_gmean[2] * ab_med_gmean)
ab_rep3 <- ab %>% filter(replicate == 3) %>% mutate(scaled_gmean_green = gmean_green / ab_rep_medians$med_gmean[3] * ab_med_gmean)
ab_rep4 <- ab %>% filter(replicate == 4) %>% mutate(scaled_gmean_green = gmean_green / ab_rep_medians$med_gmean[4] * ab_med_gmean)
ab_rep5 <- ab %>% filter(replicate == 5) %>% mutate(scaled_gmean_green = gmean_green / ab_rep_medians$med_gmean[5] * ab_med_gmean)

ab <- rbind(ab_rep1, ab_rep2, ab_rep3, ab_rep4, ab_rep5) %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(gmean_scaled_gmean = 10^mean(log10(scaled_gmean_green), na.rm = T), median_scaled = median(scaled_gmean_green, na.rm = T))

ab_scaled_histogram <- ggplot() + scale_x_log10() + 
  geom_histogram(data = ab %>% filter(variant != "vif"), aes(x= scaled_gmean_green, fill = variant)) +
  NULL; ab_scaled_histogram

ab_scaled_plot = ggplot()+
  geom_quasirandom(data = ab, aes(x= variant, y= scaled_gmean_green, color = replicate), alpha = 0.5, size = 1) + 
  scale_y_log10()+
  geom_point(data = ab, aes(x= variant, y= median_scaled), color = "black", shape = 45, size = 3) +
  labs(x= "Variant", y= "mGreenLantern \nMFI")+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 29026.34, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dotted")+
  # facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+NULL; ab_scaled_plot

ab_plot = ggplot()+
  geom_quasirandom(data = ab, aes(x= variant, y= scaled_gmean_green), alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(10000, 100000))+
  geom_point(data = ab, aes(x= variant, y= median_scaled), color = "red", shape = 95, size = 5)+
  labs(x= NULL, y= "mGreenLantern \nMFI")+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 29026.34, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dotted")+
  # facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+NULL; ab_plot

ggsave("plots/fig2_rawdata/ab_plot.pdf", ab_plot, height = 1.5, width = 6)

# ab_save = ab %>% select(variant, replicate, gmean_scaled_gmean, median_scaled) %>% distinct()
```

```{r puncta_formation, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
nk_r1 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/nk_r1.csv")
nk_r2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/nk_r2.csv")
nk_r3 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/nk_r3.csv")
kam_r1 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/kam_r1.csv")
kam_r2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/kam_r2.csv")
oms_r1 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/oms_r1.csv")

#keys for deidentifying
filename_r1 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/filenames_r1.csv")
filename_r2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/filenames_r2.csv")
filename_r3 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/puncta_formation/filenames_r3.csv")

nk_r1 = left_join(nk_r1, filename_r1) %>% mutate(replicate = "1", user = "nk") 
nk_r2 = left_join(nk_r2, filename_r2) %>% mutate(replicate = "2", user = "nk") 
nk_r3 = left_join(nk_r3, filename_r3) %>% mutate(replicate = "3", user = "nk") 
kam_r1 = left_join(kam_r1, filename_r1) %>% mutate(replicate = "1", user = "kam") 
kam_r2 = left_join(kam_r2, filename_r2) %>% mutate(replicate = "2", user = "kam") 
oms_r1 = left_join(oms_r1, filename_r1) %>% mutate(replicate = "1", user = "oms") 

nk_r1$pct_puncta = as.numeric(nk_r1$pct_puncta)
nk_r1$total_cells = as.numeric(nk_r1$total_cells)
nk_r2$pct_puncta = as.numeric(nk_r2$pct_puncta)
nk_r2$pct_puncta = as.numeric(nk_r2$total_cells)
nk_r3$pct_puncta = as.numeric(nk_r3$pct_puncta)
nk_r3$total_cells = as.numeric(nk_r3$total_cells)

kam_r1$pct_puncta = as.numeric(kam_r1$pct_puncta)
kam_r1$total_cells = as.numeric(kam_r1$total_cells)
kam_r2$pct_puncta = as.numeric(kam_r2$pct_puncta)
kam_r2$total_cells = as.numeric(kam_r2$total_cells)

oms_r1$pct_puncta = as.numeric(oms_r1$pct_puncta)
oms_r1$total_cells = as.numeric(oms_r1$total_cells)



agg_all = bind_rows(nk_r1, nk_r3, kam_r1, kam_r2, oms_r1)
agg_all$variant = factor(agg_all$variant, c("WT","WT+tg", "R429C", "R304W", "E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H", "N80S", "E90D", "K73R", "D76G","G81C", "D84N",  "F91Y", "H72Q", "G81D", "D84E", "L92V", "L96V", "L74P", "D84G"))

agg_all$user_rep <- paste0(agg_all$user,"_",agg_all$rep)

agg_all = agg_all %>% filter(new_pct_puncta != 0) %>% group_by(replicate, variant) %>% mutate(avg_puncta = 10^mean(log10(new_pct_puncta), na.rm = T))
agg_all1 = agg_all %>% select(variant, replicate, avg_puncta) %>% distinct()
agg_all1 = agg_all1 %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(median = median(avg_puncta))

ggplot()+
  geom_quasirandom(data = agg_all1, aes(x= variant, y= avg_puncta, color = replicate), alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point(data = agg_all1, aes(x= variant, y= median), shape = 95, color = "red")+ scale_y_log10()

agg_rep_medians <- agg_all1 %>% group_by(replicate) %>% summarize(med_gmean = median(avg_puncta, na.rm = T))
agg_med_gmean = median(agg_all1$median)
agg_rep1 <- agg_all1 %>% filter(replicate == 1) %>% mutate(scaled_gmean_green = avg_puncta / agg_rep_medians$med_gmean[1] * agg_med_gmean)
agg_rep2 <- agg_all1 %>% filter(replicate == 2) %>% mutate(scaled_gmean_green = avg_puncta / agg_rep_medians$med_gmean[2] * agg_med_gmean)
agg_rep3 <- agg_all1 %>% filter(replicate == 3) %>% mutate(scaled_gmean_green = avg_puncta / agg_rep_medians$med_gmean[3] * agg_med_gmean)

aggregation <- rbind(agg_rep1, agg_rep2, agg_rep3) 
aggregation = aggregation %>% group_by(variant, replicate) %>% mutate(gmean_scaled_rep = 10^mean(log10(scaled_gmean_green), na.rm = T))

aggregation = aggregation %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(gmean_scaled_gmean = 10^mean(log10(gmean_scaled_rep), na.rm = T), scaled_median = median(gmean_scaled_rep, na.rm = T))

aggregation$variant = factor(aggregation$variant, c("neg_cntrl","WT","WT+tg", "R429C", "R304W", "E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H", "N80S", "E90D", "K73R", "D76G","G81C", "D84N",  "F91Y", "H72Q", "G81D", "D84E", "L92V", "L96V", "L74P", "D84G"))

agg_plot = ggplot()+
  geom_quasirandom(data = aggregation %>% distinct(variant, gmean_scaled_rep, replicate), aes(x= variant, y= gmean_scaled_rep), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.001, 1))+
  geom_point(data = aggregation, aes(x= variant, y= scaled_median), color = "red", shape = 95, size = 5) +
  labs(x= "Variant", y= "Aggregation")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05462179, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5)+
  # facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+NULL; agg_plot

ggsave("plots/fig2_rawdata/agg_plot.pdf", agg_plot, height = 1.5, width = 6)
```

```{r qPCR - actin, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
plasmid_key = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/plasmid_key.csv")
actin_run1_p1 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/actin_run1/actin_p1.csv")
actin_run1_p1 = left_join(actin_run1_p1, plasmid_key)

actin_run1_p2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/actin_run1/actin_p2.csv")
actin_run1_p2 = left_join(actin_run1_p2, plasmid_key)

actin_run1 = bind_rows(actin_run1_p1, actin_run1_p2)

actin_run1 = actin_run1 %>% group_by(variant, replicate) %>% mutate(mean_actin = 10^(mean(log10(Cq), na.rm = T)))
actin_run1_1 = actin_run1 %>% select(variant, mean_actin, replicate)
actin_run1_1$replicate = as.integer(actin_run1_1$replicate)
actin_run1_1 = actin_run1_1 %>% distinct(variant, replicate, mean_actin)

actin_run1_1 = actin_run1_1 %>% mutate(remove = case_when(variant == "G81D" & replicate == "3" ~ "yes",
                                                  variant == "N80S" & replicate == "3" ~ "yes",
                                                  variant != "G81D" & variant != "N80S" | replicate != "3" ~ "no"))
actin_run1_1 = actin_run1_1 %>% filter(remove == "no")
actin_run1_1 = actin_run1_1 %>% select(variant, replicate, mean_actin)

#G81D and N80S have really high actin values, so removing them from the dataset

actin_run2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/actin_run2/actin_run2_cq.csv")
actin_run2 = left_join(actin_run2, plasmid_key)
actin_run2 = actin_run2 %>% group_by(variant, replicate) %>% mutate(mean_actin = 10^(mean(log10(Cq), na.rm = T)))
actin_run2_1 = actin_run2 %>% select(variant, mean_actin, replicate)
actin_run2_1$replicate = as.integer(actin_run2_1$replicate)
actin_run2_1 = actin_run2_1 %>% distinct(variant, replicate, mean_actin)

actin = bind_rows(actin_run1_1, actin_run2_1)
```

```{r qPCR - bip, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
bip_1 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/bip_run1/bip_p1.csv") %>% filter(Target == "bip")
bip_1 = left_join(bip_1, plasmid_key)

bip_2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/bip_run1/bip_p2.csv") %>% filter(Target == "bip" & remove == "no")
bip_2 = left_join(bip_2, plasmid_key)

bip_3 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/bip_run2/bip_cq.csv") %>% filter(Target == "bip")
bip_3 = left_join(bip_3, plasmid_key)

bip_new = bind_rows(bip_1, bip_2, bip_3)

bip_new1 = bip_new %>% group_by(variant, replicate) %>% mutate(mean_bip = 10^mean(log10(Cq), na.rm = T)) %>% select(variant, replicate, mean_bip) %>% distinct(variant, replicate, mean_bip)
bip_new1 = left_join(bip_new1, actin)
bip_new1 = bip_new1 %>% mutate(cq_diff = abs((mean_bip - mean_actin)))
bip_new1 = bip_new1 %>% mutate(delta_cq = 2^-cq_diff)
bip_new1$variant[bip_new1$variant == "vif"] = "neg_cntrl"



bip_new1$variant = factor(bip_new1$variant, c("neg_cntrl","WT","R429C", "R304W", "E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H", "N80S", "E90D", "K73R", "D76G","G81C", "D84N",  "F91Y", "H72Q", "G81D", "D84E", "L92V", "L96V", "L74P", "D84G"))
bip_new1$replicate = as.character(bip_new1$replicate)

bip_new1 = bip_new1 %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(mean_deltacq = 10^mean(log10(delta_cq), na.rm = T), median_deltacq = median(delta_cq, na.rm = T))



bip_raw_histogram <- ggplot() + scale_x_log10() + 
  geom_histogram(data = bip_new1, aes(x= cq_diff, fill = replicate)) +
  NULL; bip_raw_histogram

bip_raw_plot = ggplot(data = bip_new1, aes(x= variant, y= delta_cq, color = replicate))+
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) + scale_y_log10()+
  geom_point(data = bip_new1, aes(x= variant, y= median_deltacq), color = "black", shape = 45, size = 3) +
  labs(x= "Variant", y= "BiP ΔCq")+
  # facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+NULL; bip_raw_plot

## Scaled
rep_medians <- bip_new1 %>% group_by(replicate) %>% summarize(med_ddcq = median(delta_cq, na.rm = T))
med_ddcq <- median(rep_medians$med_ddcq)

bip_new1_rep1 <- bip_new1 %>% filter(replicate == 1) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[1] * med_ddcq)
bip_new1_rep2 <- bip_new1 %>% filter(replicate == 2) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[2] * med_ddcq)
bip_new1_rep3 <- bip_new1 %>% filter(replicate == 3) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[3] * med_ddcq)
bip_new1_rep4 <- bip_new1 %>% filter(replicate == 4) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[4] * med_ddcq)
bip_new1_rep5 <- bip_new1 %>% filter(replicate == 5) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[5] * med_ddcq)

bip_new1 <- rbind(bip_new1_rep1, bip_new1_rep2, bip_new1_rep3, bip_new1_rep4, bip_new1_rep5) %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(gmean_scaled_delta_cq = 10^mean(log10(scaled_delta_cq), na.rm = T), median_scaled = median(scaled_delta_cq, na.rm = T))

bip_all = ggplot()+
  geom_quasirandom(data = bip_new1, aes(x= variant, y= scaled_delta_cq), alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.01, 0.3))+
  geom_point(data = bip_new1, aes(x= variant, y= median_scaled), color = "red", shape = 95, size = 5) +
  labs(x= NULL, y= "BiP ΔCq")+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05894481, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dotted")+
  # facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+NULL; bip_all
ggsave("plots/fig2_rawdata/bip_all.pdf", bip_all, height = 1.5, width = 6)
```

```{r qPCR - nfkb1, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
nfkb$variant[nfkb$variant == "vif"] = "neg_cntrl"

nfkb$variant = factor(nfkb$variant, c("neg_cntrl","WT","R429C","R304W", "E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H", "N80S", "E90D", "K73R", "D76G","G81C", "D84N",  "F91Y", "H72Q", "G81D", "D84E", "L92V", "L96V", "L74P", "D84G"))

nfkb_all = ggplot()+
  geom_quasirandom(data = nfkb, aes(x= variant, y= scaled_delta_cq), alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.003, 0.1))+
  geom_point(data = nfkb, aes(x= variant, y= median_scaled), color = "red", shape = 95, size = 5) +
```

```{r qPCR - nfatc1, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
nfat_run1_p1 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/nfat_run1/nfat_p1_cq.csv")
nfat_run1_p1 = left_join(nfat_run1_p1, plasmid_key)

nfat_run1_p2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/nfat_run1/nfat_p2_cq.csv")
nfat_run1_p2 = left_join(nfat_run1_p2, plasmid_key)

nfat_run1 = bind_rows(nfat_run1_p1, nfat_run1_p2)
nfat_run1 = nfat_run1 %>% filter(Target == "nfat")

nfat_run1_2 = nfat_run1 %>% group_by(variant, replicate) %>% mutate(mean_cq = exp(mean(log(Cq), na.rm = T))) %>% distinct(variant, Target, replicate, mean_cq) %>% filter(Target == "nfat")
nfat_run1_2 = left_join(nfat_run1_2, actin)
nfat_run1_2 = nfat_run1_2 %>% mutate(Cq_diff = abs(mean_cq - mean_actin))
# nfat_run1_2$replicate = as.character(nfat_run1_2$replicate)

#nfat run 3
nfat_run2 = read.csv("data/bulk_assay_data/qPCR/nfat_run2/nfat_cq.csv")
nfat_run2 = left_join(nfat_run2, plasmid_key)
nfat_run2_1 = nfat_run2 %>% group_by(variant, replicate) %>% mutate(mean_cq = exp(mean(log(Cq), na.rm = T))) %>% distinct(variant, Target, replicate, mean_cq) %>% filter(Target == "nfat")
nfat_run2_1 = left_join(nfat_run2_1, actin)

nfat_run2_1 = nfat_run2_1 %>% mutate(Cq_diff = abs(mean_cq - mean_actin))
# nfat_run2_1$replicate = as.character(nfat_run2_1$replicate)


## Scaled
nfat <- rbind(nfat_run1_2, nfat_run2_1) %>% filter(!is.na(variant)) %>% mutate(delta_cq = 2^-Cq_diff) %>% filter(Cq_diff < 30) %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(var_mean_cqdiff = mean(Cq_diff))


nfat_scaled_histogram <- ggplot() + 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) + 
  geom_histogram(data = nfat, aes(x= Cq_diff, fill = variant)) +
  NULL; nfat_scaled_histogram

ggplot(data = nfat, aes(x= variant, y=delta_cq, color = replicate))+
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.5) + labs(title = "new") + 
  # facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) + 
  # geom_point(data = nfat, aes(x= variant, y= var_mean_cqdiff), color = "black", shape = 45, size = 5) +
  NULL

rep_medians <- nfat %>% group_by(replicate) %>% summarize(med_ddcq = median(delta_cq, na.rm = T))
med_ddcq <- median(rep_medians$med_ddcq)

nfat_rep1 <- nfat %>% filter(replicate == 1) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[1] * med_ddcq)
nfat_rep2 <- nfat %>% filter(replicate == 2) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[2] * med_ddcq)
nfat_rep3 <- nfat %>% filter(replicate == 3) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[3] * med_ddcq)
nfat_rep4 <- nfat %>% filter(replicate == 4) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[4] * med_ddcq)
nfat_rep5 <- nfat %>% filter(replicate == 5) %>% mutate(scaled_delta_cq = delta_cq / rep_medians$med_ddcq[5] * med_ddcq)

nfat <- rbind(nfat_rep1, nfat_rep2, nfat_rep3, nfat_rep4, nfat_rep5) %>% group_by(variant) %>% mutate(gmean_scaled_delta_cq = 10^mean(log10(scaled_delta_cq), na.rm = T), median_scaled = median(scaled_delta_cq, na.rm = T))

scaled_rep_medians <- nfat %>% group_by(replicate) %>% summarize(med_ddcq = median(scaled_delta_cq, na.rm = T))

nfat_scaled_histogram <- ggplot() + scale_x_log10() + 
  geom_histogram(data = nfat, aes(x= scaled_delta_cq, fill = variant)) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) +
  NULL; nfat_scaled_histogram

nfat_scaled_plot = ggplot()+
  geom_quasirandom(data = nfat, aes(x= variant, y= scaled_delta_cq, color = replicate), alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_y_log10()+
  geom_point(data = nfat, aes(x= variant, y= gmean_scaled_delta_cq), color = "black", shape = 45, size = 5) +
  labs(x= "Variant", y= "nfat ΔCq")+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")+NULL; nfat_scaled_plot

nfat$variant[nfat$variant == "vif"] = "neg_cntrl"

nfat$variant = factor(nfat$variant, c("neg_cntrl","WT","R429C", "R304W", "E66K", "A67T", "R69C", "R69H", "N80S", "E90D", "K73R", "D76G","G81C", "D84N",  "F91Y", "H72Q", "G81D", "D84E", "L92V", "L96V", "L74P", "D84G"))

nfat_all = ggplot()+
  geom_quasirandom(data = nfat, aes(x= variant, y= scaled_delta_cq), alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.0001, 0.01))+
  geom_point(data = nfat, aes(x= variant, y= median_scaled), color = "red", shape = 95, size = 5) +
  labs(x= NULL, y= "NFATc1 ΔCq")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0008430855, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5)+
  # facet_grid(rows = vars(replicate)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+NULL; nfat_all

ggsave("plots/fig2_rawdata/nfat_all.pdf", nfat_all, height = 1.5, width = 6)
```

```{r creating a single dataframe of all readouts, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
write.csv(all_data, "data/all_data_vus.csv")
```

#Processing REVEL scores 
```{r REVEL, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#REVEL scores were generated by downloading the “Chromosome 11: 000168961 - 005537458” genome segment file from the website (https://sites.google.com/site/revelgenomics/downloads/revel-genome-segment-files?authuser=0), filtering the data to variants associated with STIM1 Ensembl ID ENST00000300737 and converting the genome coordinates of each substitution to amino acid changes using genomeToProtein function from Ensembldb library

revel = read.csv("data/revel_chr11.csv")
revel = revel %>% separate_longer_delim(cols = Ensembl_transcriptid, delim = ";") 
revel_stim1 = revel %>% dplyr::filter(Ensembl_transcriptid == "ENST00000300737")
library(ensembldb)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)

edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86
revel_stim1$grch38_pos = as.numeric(revel_stim1$grch38_pos)


revel_stim1$chr <- gsub("chr", "", as.character(revel_stim1$chr))


gn_coords <- GRanges(
  seqnames = revel_stim1$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = revel_stim1$grch38_pos, end = revel_stim1$grch38_pos),
  tx_id = revel_stim1$Ensemble_transcriptID  # Save the transcript ID as metadata
)


aa_mapped <- genomeToProtein(gn_coords, edb)

aa_df <- as.data.frame(aa_mapped)

aa_df_filtered <- aa_df[aa_df$tx_id == "ENST00000300737", ]
colnames(aa_df_filtered)[11] = "grch38_pos"
aa_df_filtered1 = aa_df_filtered %>% dplyr::select(tx_id, grch38_pos, start, end)

revel_stim1 = left_join(revel_stim1, aa_df_filtered1)

revel_stim1_ef = revel_stim1 %>% dplyr::filter(start %in% c(63:98))

revel_stim1_ef = revel_stim1_ef %>% unite(col = "variant", aaref, start, aaalt, sep = "", remove = FALSE)
revel_stim1_ef1 = revel_stim1_ef %>% dplyr::select(variant, REVEL) %>% distinct()

write.csv(revel_stim1_ef1, "data/revel_stim1_ef.csv")

ggplot()+
  geom_histogram(data = revel_stim1_ef1, aes(x= REVEL), alpha = 0.5, color = "black", fill = "grey")+
  geom_histogram(data = revel_stim1_ef1 %>% dplyr::filter(variant %in% c("H72Q", "D84G", "G81D", "L96V", "L92V")), aes(x= REVEL), fill = "red")+
  geom_histogram(data = revel_stim1_ef1 %>% dplyr::filter(variant %in% c("A67T", "E66K", "R69C", "R69H")), aes(x= REVEL), fill = "green")
```
